description: Rerun of covid_boarding_screen_v1 on the declared scenario (boarding channel opt-out for sars_cov2_resp). In v1 every cell also boarded an undeclared prevalence-drawn cohort of about 34 hosts, so the 1 vs 3 import and infection-age axes were perturbations on that cohort and the screen was uninformative. Same axes, same matched seeds; v1 and v2 cells are paired by (Theta, infection_age_days, imports, seed).
note: 3 Theta x 3 ages x 2 import counts x 10 seeds = 180 cells. Seeds are the first ten of covid_first_look_v2's fit seeds, but the v2 cells are not a paired baseline for this screen because the visit mode differs; the age-0/one-import column is.
